text:
Excellent Service

I had a great experience with this dentist. The staff were friendly, professional, and welcoming, and the dentist explained everything clearly throughout the treatment. I felt comfortable and well taken care of. Highly recommended!

We had an emergency on our holidays where we passed through Montenegro beginning of august. Looking for a dentist on google, the rates here were really good and we were able to contact the dentist via WhatsApp. The reaction was super fast and we had an appointment half an hour later !!! Everything was perfectly explained in English and after the treatment and some prescriptions for antibiotics we even had a personal follow up the days after which was quite reassuring. Very kind, helpful and clear, I can only recommend Dr Zoran and his team.
The place is nice and the service is friendly.
Comfy place for dentists and friendly and professional doctors
Thank you, Dr Vučetić. Your professionalism, helpfulness, and kindness were outstanding. You saved my holiday.

Fantastic experience with a professional dentist. I was very nervous about getting a tooth removed, but the Zoran and the team kept me calm and comfortable throughout the entire procedure. The aftercare was exceptional as well, including the ability to ask follow-up questions via WhatsApp. If you need dental care, especially as an anxious patient or traveler, this is the best place to go!

Every year, we come to Montenegro for our holiday, and we always make time to visit the best dental clinic in Montenegro. Excellent quality at a very reasonable price, with a professional and friendly approach. We highly recommend this clinic — 100%! 🇲🇪🦷❤️

Absolutely outstanding service. I initially contacted the clinic because I needed emergency dental treatment while on holiday in Kotor, and the care I received was so good that I actually decided to have a root canal done while I was there!

From the first appointment, everyone was incredibly professional, reassuring and kind. Everything was explained clearly, the treatment was excellent, and I felt completely at ease. The clinic itself is modern, spotless and extremely well equipped, and communication in English was excellent.

The whole experience genuinely puts the dental service I’ve experienced back home in Britain to shame. The standard of treatment and care was exceptional, yet it cost a fraction of what I would have expected to pay in the UK.

You know you’ve found a good dentist when you go in for an emergency while on holiday and voluntarily go back for a root canal! 😂

I honestly can’t recommend them highly enough. If I lived anywhere near Kotor, this would without question be my regular dentist. Thank you so much for looking after me — absolutely brilliant from start to finish. ❤️
Svaka pohvala za profesionalnost, ljubaznost i brzinu. Veliki esteta i detalji su najbitniji u ovom poslu. Savjetujem svakom da dodje u njihov studio.

I had a dental emergency while visiting Montenegro, and Dr.  Zoran was exceptional!  He was able to help me on a Saturday when they were closed, scheduled a follow-up appointment on Monday, and even checked on me twice afterward to see how I was doing. His kindness, professionalism, and genuine concern meant so much to me. I am incredibly grateful for the excellent care I received and highly recommend Dr. Zoran and his team!

The dental care was excellent. We were very satisfied with the result. My husband had a hard pain. Immediately we arrived, his tooth was treated very professionally. They were very professional and kind. Everything was explained very clearly. After the care the pain disappeared soon. I highly recommend, the atmosphere was also pleasant.

Totally recommended. Took me for an emergency appointment while on holiday, and removed my inflamed operculum in a quick and pain free lazer surgery, which provided me with instant relief and allowed me to enjoy my vacation. Thanks a lot !!!

I had an excellent experience at this dental clinic. From the moment I arrived, Dr. Zoran was welcoming and highly professional. He checked and scanned my broken veneer and took the time to explain each step, which made me feel comfortable and well informed.

The clinic is clean, modern, and well organized, reflecting its high standard of care. The treatment was gentle, efficient, and exceeded my expectations. I especially appreciated the attention to detail.

I am extremely satisfied with the results and grateful for the outstanding service I received. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a skilled, professional, and caring dentist in Kotor Montenegro🫶🏻🇲🇪🫡. Thank you for making my dental experience such a positive one.

Ich bin sehr zufrieden! Ich habe mehrere Halsfüllungen machen lassen und alles verlief schnell, professionell und völlig unkompliziert. Das gesamte Team war freundlich und hat sich Zeit genommen. Die Behandlung war angenehm und das Ergebnis ist super. Klare Empfehlung – ich komme gerne wieder!

Such a beautiful experience. I forgot the reason i came. Aesthetically pleasing, relaxing music, state of the art equipment.
Professional treatment and aftercare advice. I wanted to sleep after my root canal. Certainly recommend.
Thank youu Dr zoran and his assistan maja for professionalism and kindness ,, highlyy recommendd this clinicc ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Highly recommend .. I had a cleaning here. Very easy to schedule on WhatsApp, conveniently located to my apt. in Dobrota. Very relaxing, thorough, & comfortable experience ..
As a dentist i can say he is a real gentleman and proffessinal you should visit there if you have any trouble with your mouth

I had pain in my wisdom tooth. Dr Vucetic got me in within 24 hours, took imaging and did the procedure necessary within 90 minutes of walking in his office. He was very knowledgable and helpful through the whole experience. Can recommend to anyone needing a dentist in Kotor!
Nasa najbolja doktorica Sanja!
